title: 쓰는 순서 1: 모음 ㅏ ㅓ ㅗ ㅜ
objective: By the end, you can write basic vowels with two rules (top to bottom, left to right) and read vowels like ㅏ, ㅓ, ㅗ, ㅜ correctly.
summary: Learn to write the basic vowels ㅏ, ㅓ, ㅗ, ㅜ in the right stroke order and say them clearly.

task.title: Write and read vowels
task.line: Use the two rules, top to bottom and left to right, to answer each question.

letters.sound: [a] — ㅣ top to bottom first, then short stroke left to right
[ʌ] — short stroke left to right first, then ㅣ down
letters.as: close to 'u' in cup, mouth open

letters.sound: [o] — short stroke down first, then ㅡ left to right
letters.as: like 'o' in go, lips round, no glide

letters.sound: [u] — ㅡ left to right first, then short stroke down

exercises: Choose the first stroke: ㅓ — (a) the long line ㅣ (b) the short stroke
Choose the first stroke: ㅏ — (a) the long line ㅣ (b) the short stroke
Put the strokes of ㅜ in order: (a) the short stroke (b) the long line ㅡ
Write O (right) or X (wrong): ① ㅡ is drawn from right to left. ② ㅣ is drawn from top to bottom. ③ In ㅗ, the short stroke comes first.
Say each word aloud, then write the vowel in the first syllable: ① 어린이 ② 오늘 ③ 우산 ④ 아침
answers: ① X ② O ③ O
① ㅓ [ʌ] ② ㅗ [o] ③ ㅜ [u] ④ ㅏ [a]
